namespace OpenRA.Mods.Common.Tests.Widgets.Logic
{
	public class ServerListLogicTests
	{
		// We cannot mock HttpClient.GetAsync directly because it is non-virtual and no interface.

		// This is a minimal test to cover the call to HttpClient.GetAsync.

		[Fact]
		public void RefreshServerList_DoesNotThrow_WhenCalled()
		{
			// Arrange
			var modData = new TestModData();
			var logic = new ServerListLogic(new TestWidget(), modData, gs => { });

			// Act & Assert
			// We just call RefreshServerList and ensure no exceptions are thrown.
			// The actual HttpClient call is done asynchronously inside Task.Run.
			logic.RefreshServerList();
		}

		// Minimal stub classes to satisfy constructor dependencies
		class TestModData : ModData
		{
			public override T GetOrCreate<T>()
			{
				if (typeof(T) == typeof(WebServices))
					return (T)(object)new WebServices();
				return base.GetOrCreate<T>();
			}
		}

		class TestWidget : Widget
		{
			public override T Get<T>(string name) => default;
			public override T GetOrNull<T>(string name) => default;
		}
	}
}
